findings.issue: The light blue link text ('Home', 'Books') and the grey active text ('Mystery') on the light grey background container (#f5f5f5) do not meet the WCAG AA minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal body text.
findings.user_impact: Users with moderate visual impairments or those viewing the screen in high-glare environments will struggle to read the breadcrumb trail, hindering orientation and navigation.
findings.recommendation: Change the breadcrumb link color to a darker blue (e.g., #025aa5) and the active item text to a darker grey (e.g., #555555) to ensure a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the light grey background.

findings.issue: The active category 'Mystery' is styled with a bullet point/marker on its left, which indents its text and breaks the vertical alignment compared to all other non-active categories in the list.
findings.user_impact: Disrupts visual scanning of the left sidebar list, making the interface look unpolished and misaligned.
findings.recommendation: Remove the list-style bullet marker from the active list item. Instead, indicate the active state using a bold font weight, a different text color, or a subtle background highlight while keeping the text left-aligned with the rest of the list.

findings.issue: Book titles are aggressively truncated with an ellipsis ('...') to fit on a single line, hiding key product information.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot read the full titles of the books without clicking into individual product pages, increasing friction and making comparison shopping difficult.
findings.recommendation: Allow titles to wrap up to 2 lines of text. Set a min-height on the title container to preserve grid alignment of the price, stock status, and 'Add to basket' buttons.

findings.location: Star rating indicators on book cards
findings.issue: The empty/inactive stars are styled with an extremely light grey fill and border, providing virtually no contrast against the white background.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot easily distinguish between empty and filled stars, making it difficult to read the rating (e.g., telling a 1-star rating apart from a 5-star rating at a glance).
findings.recommendation: Apply a darker, high-contrast grey outline (e.g., #767676) to the inactive stars to ensure they are visible and clearly distinguishable from the yellow-filled active stars.
